key.name: presets
key.description: Delays, in minutes, offered directly in the top bar menu.

key.name: show-countdown
key.summary: Show countdown in the top bar
key.description: Display the remaining time next to the icon while a shutdown is scheduled.

key.name: warnings-enabled
key.description: Notify before the computer shuts down, with options to postpone or cancel.

key.name: warning-minutes
key.description: Minutes before the shutdown at which a warning notification is shown.

key.name: last-custom-minutes
key.description: The delay last chosen in the custom time dialog, used as its starting value.

key.name: dry-run
key.description: Schedule a logind “dry-poweroff” instead of a real power off. Everything behaves normally, but the computer does not turn off when the timer ends.
